honing_confound: Demon Form skill damage scales with Specialization (gear honing). Specialization increases BOTH demon skill damage AND Shadowburst Meter generation speed — dual-axis scaling. At T4, faster transformation cycling compounds the burst window frequency for significant throughput advantage.

delivery.evidence: Human form: Intrude skills (Demon Vision, Demon's Grip) are medium-range reaching attacks that fill meter. Demon Form: Blood Demon (multi-hit target), Blood Vortex (zone), Bloody Piercing (line thrust), Blood Marsh (zone field). Non-positional in demon form — no back-attack requirement.

footprint.evidence: Demon form creates varied footprints: Blood Vortex is a zone centered on target, Blood Marsh lays a ground field, Blood Demon hits in sequence. Mix of target-point and zone within demon form.

geo_text: Demonic Impulse Shadowhunter fills Shadowburst Meter via Intrude skills (human form builders) → Demonize (Z): transformation grants +30% Crit Rate, +20% Move Speed, Paralysis Immunity during animation, and access to Demon Form skill set. In Demon Form: use Blood Demon / Blood Vortex / Bloody Piercing / Blood Marsh for burst. Gain Chaos Fragments via demon skill hits; after 2 Chaos Fragment gains → return to human form. DEMONIC IMPULSE IDENTITY: removes transformation cooldown period on return → immediate meter rebuild → fast Demonize re-entry.

control.evidence: Demon form skills have knockdown effects on some hits. No CC-centered identity. Note: Blood Vortex name implies possible pull/zone behavior — not confirmed from live sources as a true pull.

defense.evidence: Paralysis Immunity during Demonize transformation animation — brief invulnerability during the transform. Human form relies on dodge. Moderate armor. Leaping Blow (demon form) provides push immunity.

economy.resource_verbatim: Shadowburst Meter (fills to max for Demonize)
economy.builder_source: Intrude skills (Demon Vision, Demon's Grip, etc.) fill Shadowburst Meter in human form. Chaos Fragments (gained in demon form) govern demon form exit timing.
economy.plain_text: DEMONIZE CYCLE ECONOMY: Intrude skills fill Shadowburst Meter → at max: Demonize (Z) transforms into Demon Form → Demon Form skills attack and generate Chaos Fragments (on hits) → 2 Chaos Fragment triggers → return to human form. DEMONIC IMPULSE IDENTITY: no cooldown on return → immediately rebuild Shadowburst Meter → Demonize again. Identity: maximize demon-form uptime via fast cycle repetition.

element.evidence: Human Intrude skills use dark energy. Demon Form skills use demonic dark energy. Both Physical/Dark damage type.

movement.evidence: Good mobility. Demonize grants +20% Move Speed. Demon Form: Leaping Blow is a gap-closer with push immunity. Human form has standard assassin dash capability.

attr.evidence: Human Intrude skills reach 5-15m. Demon Form skills work at 0-10m close range (non-positional). Not pure melee — demon form has more effective reach than pure blade classes.

range.evidence: Human form: 5-15m for Intrude skills. Demon form: 0-10m for demon skill set. Effective engagement range is melee to short-medium.

tempo.evidence: Demonic Impulse is the burst identity: fill meter → transform → burst damage in demon form → return → rebuild fast. Transformation windows are the damage concentration points.

amp.value: Demon Form: +30% Crit Rate, +20% Move Speed, demon skill access, Paralysis Immunity during transform animation; no cooldown on transform return (DI identity)
amp.evidence: Maxroll DI guide: 'Demonize: 20% Move Speed, 30% Crit Rate, Access to Demon Skills, Paralysis Immunity during the entire transformation.' DI engraving removes return cooldown — sourced from same guide.

proxy.evidence: No proxy mechanics. Demon form is a self-transformation, not a summon.

commitment.evidence: Demonize has a transformation animation. Demon form skills (Blood Vortex, Blood Marsh) have cast animations. Not instant — wind-up on primary damage deliverers in demon form.

mechanics_notes: 1) NO-COOLDOWN RETURN mechanic (DI identity): the critical design is eliminating downtime between Demonize windows. Base Shadowhunter has a meter-drain / recovery period after returning to human form. DI removes this → immediate rebuild cycle. This is LA's clearest 'remove the punishing downtime' identity design (similar to Evolutionary Legacy Machinist's 40% Core Energy refund logic). 2) PARALYSIS IMMUNITY DURING TRANSFORMATION: the Demonize animation grants Paralysis Immunity — a brief invulnerability during the vulnerable cast. Adds raid-mechanic tolerance not visible from delivery schema alone. 3) NON-POSITIONAL in Demon Form: unlike Deathblade's back-attack requirement, Demon Form skills hit from any angle. Significantly lower positioning demand than other melee assassins. 4) DI vs PS design fork: DI maximizes transformation burst uptime via fast cycling; PS removes transformation entirely for human-form sustained output with Shadowburst Meter used as skill empowerment fuel.
stabilization_patch: Demonic Impulse has been dominant Shadowhunter identity throughout global history.
tier_standing_current: A-tier (Maxroll community tier list August 2025). HONING-CONFOUND NOTE: Demon Form skill damage at T4 Specialization is competitive — Specialization scales both damage and meter generation speed simultaneously, creating strong honing returns.

honing_confound: Perfect Suppression's Spender skill damage scales with Swiftness and Crit (gear honing) rather than Specialization. The skill amplification from Shadowburst Meter expenditure compounds with gear crit stats. Lower Specialization dependency reduces honing confound relative to DI but Swiftness gear is more expensive in some gear tier contexts.

delivery.evidence: Perfect Suppression uses human form only. Multi-hit Intrude skills as builders; Spender skills (empowered by Shadowburst Meter) as damage deliverers. Skills have forced displacement mechanics (push/pull-adjacent movements on hit targets).

footprint.evidence: Human form skills: multi-hit melee-range attacks. Thrust Impact (primary Spender) is a forward thrust-line. Some multi-hit skills create small burst areas but no large AoE identity.

geo_text: Perfect Suppression Shadowhunter disables Demonize entirely. Shadowburst Meter fills via Intrude skills (same as DI) but is spent in 20% chunks to empower Spender skills (damage amp + buff). Storm Grinding Ark Passive: Spender use generates Shadow Shards → 3 stacks → Shadow Injection → next Storm Grinding restores 20% meter. PS identity bonuses: Attack Speed + Move Speed buff, Normal skill damage increased, Thrust Impact (Spender) greatly amplified.

control.evidence: Multi-hit skills have knockdown on impact. Forced displacement mechanics on some skills. No CC-centered identity.

defense.evidence: Human form only — no Paralysis Immunity from Demonize (unlike DI). Weakness noted in Maxroll: 'Lack of Paralysis Immunity.' Standard dodge-based defense.

economy.builder_source: Intrude skills fill Shadowburst Meter. Spenders consume 20% per use. Storm Grinding Ark Passive creates Shadow Shard → Shadow Injection at 3 stacks → 20% meter restore.
economy.plain_text: SPENDER-EMPOWERMENT ECONOMY: Intrude skills fill Shadowburst Meter → Spender skills consume 20% each for empowered hit + buff. SHADOW INJECTION LOOP: each Spender generates Shadow Shard → 3 stacks → Shadow Injection → next Storm Grinding restores 20% meter. PS IDENTITY: Normal skill damage + Thrust Impact (Spender) damage amplified. Economy is a builder-spender loop with meter restoration feedback — self-sustaining cycle with Demonize path permanently closed.

element.evidence: Same Physical / Dark energy as human form skills. No demon-form elemental conversion.

movement.evidence: PS grants Move Speed buff (via PS identity bonuses). Human form dash capability. No Demonize Move Speed bonus — compensated by PS Attack + Move Speed buff.

attr.evidence: Human form only. Intrude skill range similar to Demonic Impulse human form: 5-15m. No demon form melee closing required.

range.evidence: Human Intrude and Spender skills: medium range. No need to close to demon-form melee range.

tempo.evidence: Perfect Suppression is sustained: builder-spender loop continuously cycling. No large burst window like Demonize. Consistent output via empowered Spender skills on cooldown.

amp.value: Thrust Impact: greatly increased Spender damage; Normal skill damage buffed; Attack Speed + Move Speed passive buff from PS identity
amp.evidence: Maxroll PS guide: 'Attack and Move Speed, and Normal skill damage' and 'greatly increased Thrust Impact damage.' Specific percentages not extracted from live source.

commitment.evidence: Multi-hit skills are rapid-fire sequences. Spender skills are fast empowered shots. High Swiftness build enables near-instant casts.

mechanics_notes: 1) PERFECT SUPPRESSION IS THE ANTI-TRANSFORMATION IDENTITY: the entire damage arc exists in human form only. This removes both the burst peak (Demonize) AND the vulnerability of transformation animation (including DI's Paralysis Immunity). Trade: consistent output vs demon-form burst ceiling. 2) SHADOW INJECTION FEEDBACK LOOP (Ark Passive): the Storm Grinding → Shadow Shard → Shadow Injection → 20% meter restore is a self-sustaining economy mechanic. Skilled PS players can achieve high Spender frequency via this restoration loop. 3) LACK OF PARALYSIS IMMUNITY is the stated weakness: unlike DI which is immune during transformation, PS has no immunity frames. Makes PS more vulnerable to interrupts in boss content. 4) SAME PATTERN as other 'simplification' identities: PS = Control Glaivier, FI Wardancer, Reflux Sorceress, Energy Overflow Soulfist — removes complex mode for sustained simplified output. 5) Both DI and PS are A-tier (Maxroll Aug 2025) — unusual case where both identities are equally valued in endgame content.
stabilization_patch: Perfect Suppression historically secondary; both identities are A-tier as of 2025 tier lists.
tier_standing_release: B-tier at launch (DI was meta; PS was niche)
tier_standing_current: A-tier (Maxroll community tier list August 2025). HONING-CONFOUND NOTE: Swiftness/Crit-indexed vs Specialization — lower honing confound than DI but different stat investment curve.
